title: An adaptive discretization algorithm for locally optimal experimental design with constraints
summary: We develop a novel iterative algorithm for locally optimal experimental design under constraints, like budget or performance constraints. It is an adaptive discretization algorithm. In every iteration, a discretized version of the constrained-design problem is solved and then the discretization is adaptively refined by adding an approximate violator of a suitable sufficient $\eps$-optimality condition for the current design. We prove that with $\eps = 0$, our algorithm converges to an optimal design and that with $\eps > 0$, our algorithm finitely terminates at an $\eps$-optimal design.…
